summary: Live acceptance fixture asserts each conjunct before any side effect: fresh isolated config/data/cache paths, tmux -L panopticon has-session nonzero, docker ps --all empty (catches unlabeled/legacy containers), disposable-repo name-prefix+topic+push checks, and a verified clone establishing origin (enforced again by quickstart's REQ-054.2). Non-github/non-disposable URLs are also rejected by the non-skipped config gate; no tautology or over-mock on the load-bearing host-state checks.
